title: Xiao Yan defeats Hun Miesheng
summary: In the third match, Hun Miesheng admits he sent men to the Jia Ma Empire to capture Xiao Zhan and says he will settle the Xiao clan's blood feud himself. Xiao Yan fights him with soul attacks and, for the first time, the Purifying Demonic Lotus Flame. Hun Miesheng feeds his fighting energy to the Void Devouring Flame, second on the Heavenly Flame ranking, which swallows the Demon Flame and drains Xiao Yan. Xiao Yan sees that it is only a sub-flame, the same power Hun Feng had. Little Yi comes out of him, overpowers the Void Devouring Flame, and Xiao Yan beats Hun Miesheng. Hun Miesheng flees with part of his soul and says Xiao Zhan is still in his hands. The Sky Mansion Alliance wins and is hailed as the overlord of the Central Plains.
